brief: WEB-719 (R2H-1, S1) is a regression of WP39, found by the H verifier (`verify-b3-r2-H.md`, ‘Regressions’). WP39's three findings (WEB-716, WEB-717, WEB-718) came back fixed: don't change anything else they did.

What happens today: after a recording's request fails in a way it can be resent (offline, timeout, 503), the capture stage shows `.voice-retry` (‘Try again’ / «Reintentar» / «Torna-ho a provar»). Clicking it calls `setPending(true)`. `listening` (`VoiceDemo.tsx:428`, `recording || (pending && mode === "voice")`) then turns true, so (a) the `.voice-retry` block (`:658`, rendered on `!listening`) unmounts and keyboard focus falls to `<body>`, and (b) the record circle (`:567-582`) becomes the filled `is-recording` button labelled ‘Done’ / «Listo» / «Fet», disabled, with ‘One moment…’ under it, until a fresh security token arrives and `sendNow` (`:409-415`) starts the request. ‘Done’ means ‘stop and send a recording’, which isn't what is happening, and the control the visitor used has vanished. With the real Turnstile this lasts as long as the check, longer if it asks for a tap. Evidence: inferred from code; no render shows this moment.

Fix, two lines, both from the reviewer: (1) `:428` becomes `const listening = recording || (pending && mode === "voice" && !retryPending);`. Update the comment at `:427` to say: the record button is the Done button from the first tap until the recording is sent, except while a recording is being resent with Try again. (2) The block at `:658` renders on `mode === "voice" && retryPending && audio && !recording` (not `!listening`). Keep its `className="button voice-retry"`, `onClick={() => setPending(true)}`, the label `t.tryAgain` and the comment above it.

Result while the resend waits for its token: the record circle stays the plain ‘Tap to talk’ / «Toca para hablar» / «Toca per parlar» circle, disabled (its `disabled={unavailable}` already covers `pending`); Try again stays in place, disabled; the hint under the microphone (`:592-601`) reads `One moment…` / `Un momento…` / `Un moment…` (existing `t.starting`, shown because `pending`). No new string. When the token arrives, `submit` sets `busy` and the processing stage takes over and moves focus to its heading, as today.

Focus: the button must keep keyboard focus while it waits. If, on either Playwright project, focus leaves `.voice-retry` once it becomes `disabled` (the browser's focus fix-up can move it to `<body>`), then while `pending` is true mark it `aria-disabled="true"` instead of `disabled`, and make its click a no-op while pending (`onClick={() => { if (!pending) setPending(true); }}`), keeping `disabled` for the other reasons in `unavailable` (`busy`, `loading`, `recording`): `disabled={unavailable && !pending}`, `aria-disabled={pending || undefined}`. Say in your notes which way you went and why. Don't change the record button's own disabling or focus: the focus loss on ‘Tap to talk’ noted in round 2 is WP29's.

Check the normal path is unchanged: `record()` clears `retryPending` (`:280-282`), so a fresh recording and its Done (`finish`, `:253-255`) still show ‘Done’ disabled with ‘One moment…’ until the recording is sent. Typed mode's Done block (`:644-655`) is untouched. `listening` is used only at `:428`, `:571-583` and `:658`; nothing else changes.
